name: Nebraska City
seo_title: Nebraska City Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Nebraska City, Nebraska for 2026: 3 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's page.
lede: Nebraska City starts Christmas at Arbor Day Farm with a free tree lighting and trolley, then a ticketed Christmas Tea in Arbor Lodge Mansion and a free Winterpalooza with Santa photos at the Veterans Memorial Building.
celebrates: Arbor Day Farm anchors the season with Kickoff to Christmas on Friday, December 4, 2026, a free evening with a trolley, a tree lighting at Arbor Lodge Mansion at 5:30 pm, Santa and Mrs. Claus photos at Apple House Market and live music at Lied Lodge, according to the farm's own page. The Morton-James Public Library follows with Winterpalooza on December 12.
lastyear: The Nebraska City News-Press covered the 2024 Winterpalooza as a community effort by Nebraska City Tourism and Commerce and the Morton-James Public Library, with free Santa photos and activities for families.
facts: Arbor Lodge Mansion is part of Arbor Lodge State Historical Park at 2600 Arbor Avenue and was the home of the Morton family. The Nebraska Game and Parks calendar also lists a Christmas Candlelight Tour on December 4, which it calls suitable for older kids, teens and adults.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Nebraska City this Christmas. The Arbor Day Farm Trolley runs a loop between Lied Lodge and Arbor Lodge on December 4, according to the farm. For trains, the Durham Museum in Omaha's Union Station is the nearest big stop, and our museum page covers it.
train_links: The Union Station museum in Omaha, the nearest big train stop for a day out.
traditions: A free evening at Arbor Day Farm with a trolley, a mansion tree lighting and Santa photos.
Tea and treats in the sunroom of Arbor Lodge Mansion with a mansion tour.
A free library morning with Santa photos, cookies, toys and craft kits.
kidfact: Arbor Day Farm's trolley carries families from Lied Lodge to the Arbor Lodge tree lighting at 5:30 pm.
faq: What is free in Nebraska City at Christmas?
Kickoff to Christmas at Arbor Day Farm on December 4 is free, and the Morton-James Library says the photos with Santa at Winterpalooza on December 12 are free.
When is the Christmas Tea at Arbor Lodge?
December 12 at 10 am and 2 pm, and December 13 at 1 pm, at $35 per adult and $20 per child.
Yes. Santa and Mrs. Claus pose for photos at Apple House Market on December 4, and Santa photos are free at Winterpalooza on December 12.
We did not find one, but a trolley runs between Lied Lodge and Arbor Lodge on December 4.
Is the candlelight tour for young kids?
The Game and Parks calendar lists it for older kids, teens and adults, so it is not carded here.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Nebraska City for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Kickoff to Christmas at Arbor Day Farm) through December 13 (the last Christmas Tea at Arbor Lodge Mansion), with Winterpalooza at the Veterans Memorial Building on December 12 along the way. We check every date on the host's own page, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Nebraska City

  • 2 free events: Kickoff to Christmas at Arbor Day Farm and Winterpalooza (photos with Santa)
  • Meet Santa: Kickoff to Christmas (Apple House Market) and Winterpalooza
  • Christmas Tea is ticketed at $35 per adult and $20 per child
